AVA I L A B L E S U P E R C R U I S E ™

assistance feature3 for compatible
highways

on demand when turn signal is engaged
1 AKG is a trademark of AKG Acoustics GmbH, registered in the United States and/or other countries.
2 Standard on Platinum trim level and optional on Premium Luxury and Sport trim levels.
3 Even while using the Super Cruise driver assistance feature, always pay attention while driving and do not use a
hand-held device. Visit cadillacsupercruise.com for compatible highways and more information. Requires properly
equipped vehicle, active Super Cruise subscription, working electrical system, cell reception, and GPS signal.
